annotations.title: Web Bot Auth check: key directory and signed request diagnosis

description: Web Bot Auth check: key directory and signed request diagnosis. Use when a bot or agent signs its requests with Web Bot Auth (HTTP Message Signatures, RFC 9421) and you need to see why a signature is rejected, or what a key directory publishes: it fetches and reads the JWK Set at a directory URL or a domain's well-known path, or rebuilds the signature base of a pasted signed request and checks the Ed25519 signature against the key its Signature-Agent names. Cost: 2 credits per call.

at.description: Request mode: check the time window at this moment (Unix seconds or ISO 8601) instead of now, for a request you captured earlier.

directory_url.description: Directory mode: an https URL serving the key directory (a JWK Set). Fetched by PageVerified; redirects are reported, not followed.

domain.description: Directory mode: a domain; https://<domain>/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory is fetched.

headers.description: Request mode: the signed request's headers as {name: value or [values]}, at least Signature and Signature-Input, plus Signature-Agent and every covered header. Up to 100 headers of 8,192 characters. Never fetched or stored; checked as caller_supplied.

label.description: Request mode: which signature label to check. Default: the first whose tag is web-bot-auth, else the first.

method.description: Request mode: the HTTP method, default GET. Case is kept, as RFC 9421 requires.

url.description: Request mode (required there): the absolute URL the request was sent to, for @authority, @path, @query and the like. Never fetched.

name: bot_auth_check
